text:
Sea Limited's net income attributable to ordinary shareholders for FY2025 was **US$1,578,149 thousand (~US$1.58 billion)**, up significantly from US$444,321 thousand in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70]. This resulted in basic earnings per share of US$2.65, compared to US$0.77 in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70].

For context, income before income tax and share of results of equity investees was approximately US$2.3 billion in 2025 (up from US$778.8 million in 2024), with an income tax expense of US$651.1 million in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.101].

answer:

This resulted in basic earnings per share of US$2.65, compared to US$0.77 in FY2024 [Sea, FY2025, p.F-70].

For context, income before income tax and share of results of equity investees was approximately US$2.3 billion in 2025 (up from US$778.8 million in 2024), with an income tax expense of US$651.1 million in 2025 [Sea, FY2025, p.101].
